source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 659 temporarily removes offline_access from MICROSOFT_SCOPES. 674 restores it and adds it to returnedScopes when Microsoft omits it from the token response. Current normalization accepts Microsoft tenant token endpoints through startsWith("https://login.microsoftonline.com/"); current provider definitions include offline_access for Microsoft mail and EWS. Its EWS comment explains that this requests a refresh token for reuse after restart. Treat 659 as an intermediate approach, not the current policy. The restart symptom is patch intent; no provider login or restart reproduction was run.
title: Preserve Microsoft offline_access through token scope normalization
